Subject: Draft: incident summary and timeline (for review)

Hannah / team — attaching the first draft of the technical incident summary and timeline. High level:
- 2025-11-06 03:41 UTC: anomaly detected in autoscaler interaction causing token-serving queue to back up for ~21m.
- 03:45–04:05 UTC: degraded responses for ~0.2% of requests (latency spike, no data corruption).
- 04:05 UTC: automated fallback routing activated; impacted requests routed to a read-only model pool to preserve availability.
- 04:30 UTC: root cause identified (race condition in cache eviction + kernel scheduling under heavy burst).
- 04:55 UTC: permanent mitigation deployed (patch to scheduler and tighter preflight checks).

Containment and impact: no customer data exfiltration detected; no model weights changed; logs indicate retries and increased tail latency for affected tokens.

Attachment: incident-summary-draft-2025-11-09.pdf (technical timeline + sample log excerpts, redacted)

Please review — I need approval to finalize and send to FinBank. Marcus

[Quoted for clarity: please do not circulate the draft outside core security/CS until redactions are confirmed.]

Thanks — answers inline below.

1) Log retention: request logs are retained for 90 days by default; we retain system-level audit logs for 365 days. We can produce filtered SIEM exports covering 2025-11-05 to 2025-11-09 in CSV or ndjson. We will include sample event ids in the evidence bundle (already included in evidence-export-20251109.zip).

2) Data exfiltration criteria: we examined S3/API access logs (no anomalous object reads/writes), EDR alerts (no suspicious process activity tied to data staging), and network flows for large outbound transfers. Our detection coverage includes anomaly scoring on transfer volumes and auth anomalies; none crossed threshold for confirmed exfiltration. Marcus and Vivek can provide the SIEM query and thresholds on request.

3) CAIQ mapping: the delivered IRP excerpt (Redwood-IRP-v3.2.pdf) calls out CAIQ sections CC6 (Incident Management) and CC7 (Monitoring & Logging). We will produce a short spreadsheet mapping CAIQ questions to artifacts within 48 hours if that helps your audit templates.

If you'd like a 30-minute call, Marcus and Vivek are available tomorrow 10:00–12:00 PST.

Best,
Hannah
